name: startup-from-zero-founder-decision-tree
description: The complete founder decision tree and operating guide platform.

scripts.build:
node -e "const fs = require('fs'); let guide = fs.readFileSync('guide-data.js', 'utf8').replace(/export const /g, 'const '); let tree = fs.readFileSync('tree-data.js', 'utf8').replace(/export const /g, 'const '); let app = fs.readFileSync('app.js', 'utf8').replace(/import {[^}]+} from '\./guide-data\.js';/, '').replace(/import {[^}]+} from '\./tree-data\.js';/, ''); fs.writeFileSync('bundle.js', guide + '

' + tree + '

' + app); console.log('Built bundle.js successfully');"

author: Founder Operating Guide
